title: Packaging, Tier-C Validation, Performance Proof & Legacy Cleanup
objective: Close the production Full Skin Capability gate by packaging the complete runtime declaratively, producing truthful Tier-C Skin Laboratory evidence for the two migration/reference packs plus all eighteen target packs, measuring performance/memory/switch behavior on supported runners, validating assignment/recovery/package integrity, and migrating only evidence-backed obsolete Class-B legacy theme paths while preserving compatibility adapters and historical evidence.

included: implement/complete declarative non-executable Skin Pack package manifests with version, compatibility, required/optional capabilities, integrity hashes, provenance/license references, accessibility completeness and safe fallback metadata

exercise Ember, Chromatic and all eighteen target packs through the shared runtime and final representative SCREEN-HOME-SHELL, SCREEN-CHARACTER, SCREEN-GM-DENSE, SCREEN-LIVE-SESSION, SCREEN-COMBAT, SCREEN-INVENTORY-EQUIPMENT, SCREEN-GRAPH-MAP, SCREEN-AUTHORING, SCREEN-FORM-VALIDATION, SCREEN-AI-ADMIN and SCREEN-COMPACT-TRANSFORM evidence classes

produce truthful Tier-C evidence metadata/baselines through the existing Skin Laboratory contract, including typography companions, responsive/accessibility profiles, selection/recovery cases, hidden-information sentinels and deterministic procedural evidence

measure switch timing, repeated-switch behavior, effect-cost behavior, active/resident/peak memory and leak/residency characteristics on representative validation runners; use measured product-approved thresholds rather than invented UISK-only byte limits

validate package schema/version compatibility, required/optional capability fallback, asset/manifest integrity, provenance/license status, missing/corrupt asset handling and non-executable payload rejection
validate personal/campaign/world/temporary/preview/hot-switch/last-known-good/unavailable/incompatible/reading-preference persistence across the complete roster

migrate or refactor only Class-B live legacy theme paths after exact dependency search and replacement proof; preserve cheap compatibility aliases/adapters and Class-C historical evidence; retain talker-theme -> roses-theme continuity
exact-head Linux/Windows deterministic validation plus measured evidence receipts and final production-capability manifest
excluded: new skin identities beyond the approved roster
gameplay, permission, hidden-information, navigation, validation, provenance or AI authority changes
arbitrary executable Skin Pack plugins or network/credential-bearing packages
deletion of compatibility adapters or historical governance/evidence merely to remove legacy names
scope.completion_gate: Full Skin Capability may be called production-complete only when the complete roster resolves through the shared runtime, Tier-C evidence and approved visual baselines exist, accessibility/semantic/package/fallback gates pass, measured performance/memory/switch profiles pass approved product thresholds, deterministic/procedural evidence is repeatable, and any migrated legacy Class-B paths have exact replacement/regression/rollback evidence.

selection_boundaries: UISR-10 is selected by verified UISR-09 closeout but has no implementation authority until a later owner Continue.
Design documents alone cannot satisfy the production Full Skin Capability gate; runtime evidence must be truthful and measured.
Package payloads remain declarative and non-executable.
Legacy cleanup is evidence-backed migration/refactor, not blanket deletion: Class-A compatibility may remain and Class-C historical evidence is preserved.
Application publication remains serialized by the OPS3 merge lease and requires stale-base reconciliation/revalidation whenever another app lane publishes first.
next_action: Create focused UISR-10 RED on application base bda4936f828e636cdc8eb1ae104b0c620b0152e1 for complete 20-pack runtime availability, Secondary Trio/Rainbow materialization, declarative package validation/integrity/non-executable rejection, Tier-C SCREEN-* evidence/baseline manifest completeness, assignment/recovery matrix, measured runner performance/memory/switch receipts, and evidence-backed Class-B legacy App theme migration; then implement, capture headed-browser evidence, exact-head cross-platform validate, publish and close only on truthful Full Skin Capability proof.
